says: A first user with no Team, no account, no provider connection and no repository opens the launcher on a fresh installation: reading the local profile (access.profile.read) returns the profile the runtime wrote at this first use, active at generation 1 because of first use and naming nothing but the local principal, and every later request runs at that generation. The user then creates a local principal from a device key on this laptop (identity.binding.add, established by local creation, no evidence from any provider), and the host is probed for taking what a start hands a new session at launch. The launcher offers one qualified personal start route. The entry (surface.drive) shows the three personal positions checked, empty and marked unavailable, an optional note, focused, the tool as a suggestion marked '(제안)', the permissions as the host's own settings, also suggested, and one start action; there is no goal or task field. Tab, Tab and Enter dispatch one preparation.compose request whose basis is the personal scope alone with no source pins and no work_request; the owner stores a preparation, as the requester's own record with no receipt, of nothing selected whose task support is not requested, observed at a plain local folder, and route.select answers for that request with it. Negative: no step signs in, founds or selects a Team, binds a repository or reaches a provider; no answer carries a gap or recovery that asks for sign-in, a Team or a repository; and the missing intent is neither an error nor a guessed work_request.

set.value: The new session gave the code the adapter handed it in the instructions its host was started with.
